n01.roman: Bharat mein GTA 6 ka Standard Edition: ₹5,999.

n02.roman: Sarkaari survey PLFS ke mutabiq, naukripesha purush ki average kamaai ₹24,217 mahina. Mahila ki ₹18,353.

n03.roman: Yaani game = purush ki kareeb saadhe saat din ki kamaai. Mahila ki kareeb 10 din.

n04.roman: Par twist baaki hai! Ye game sirf PS5 aur Xbox Series X/S par aa raha hai.

n06.roman: Yaani purush ki kareeb 3 mahine ki kamaai. Aur mahila ki? Kareeb 4 mahine!
